note:
ISO 9:1995(E), clause 4 Transliteration table: Table 1 - General table for Slavic
Cyrillic characters (pp. 6-9, rows 1-46), Table 2 - Complementary table for the Slavic
Cyrillic characters used by some communities established outside the boundaries of their
native countries (p. 10, rows 48-52), Table 3 - Table for Cyrillic characters of
non-Slavic languages (p. 11, rows 1-118); held source
interscript-private-references/iso/ISO-9-1995.pdf (IHS-licensed scan; watermarked).
Extraction: the scan's OCR text layer is unusable for the character cells (mangled
Cyrillic), so every row was transcribed from rendered page images (300-1300 dpi,
No.-column-anchored row crops, gridline detection for Table 1; ambiguous cells
re-cropped at 900-1300 dpi). Instantiation: Table 3 prints one Cyrillic case and one
Latin cell per row; tests instantiate the printed cell (lowercase Cyrillic -> printed
Latin; uppercase rows only where the table prints them).
Correction table (text layer -> print): not applicable - the text layer carries no
usable character cells; the No. digits alone extract reliably and served as row anchors.
Findings (map-vs-source; transcribed rows EXCLUDED from the generated tests, never
forced green; record for the maps-fix pipeline):
1. Table 2 #48: printed ґ -> gh-circumflex (gha-circumflex: U+011D); the map encodes
   G̀ (grave). VALUE DIVERGENCE.
2. Table 2 #50: printed little-yus -> a-breve (U+0103); the map has no little-yus rule
   at all, and its a-breve value is attached to big-yus (U+04EA -> U+01CE), a letter no
   printed row of this edition carries. MISSING RULE + MISATTACHED VALUE.
3. Table 2 #52: printed yizhitsa -> y-circumflex (U+0177); the map encodes Ỳ (grave,
   U+1EF2). VALUE DIVERGENCE.
4. Table 3 #3 (a-diaeresis+macron): the print places the macron ABOVE the diaeresis
   (a-diaeresis+macron, U+01DF style); the map uses dot-below + diaeresis (U+1EA0+U+0308).
   The print is internally inconsistent: Table 3 #62 (o-diaeresis+macron) prints
   dot-below (U+1EA0+U+0308 style), matching the map and the map's hand test. The map's
   consistent dot-below convention is retained; the print inconsistency is recorded.
5. Table 3 #87 (u-diaeresis+macron): same class as #4 - print reads as macron-above
   style (partially degraded); map uses dot-below + diaeresis (U+1EE4+U+0308). UNCERTAIN.
6. Table 3 #86 (ha-with-stroke): the printed Latin mark is illegible in the held scan
   (macron vs dot-above); the map encodes U-dot-above (U+0307). UNCERTAIN - flagged.
7. Table 3 #15: the print suggests he-with-macron (U+04FF-style) with an h-based value;
   the map has only the plain he rule (U+04BB -> U+1E25). MISSING (transcription
   uncertain).
8. Table 3 #25 (dhe-with-descender): printed z-with-below-mark (comma or dot -
   illegible); the map has no dhe-with-descender rule. MISSING.
9. Table 3 t-family rows 74-77 (t-with-descender variants) and che-family rows 96-101
   (che/tse-with-descender variants incl. diaeresis forms), plus #72 (es-with-descender):
   the printed diacritics are illegible at any available magnification of the held scan.
   The map's rules for these letters (U+04AD -> U+0162, U+04B6 -> U+00C7, U+04B7 -> U+00C7,
   U+04BC -> U+0106, U+04BD -> U+0106, U+04BC-diaeresis -> C+combining-below forms,
   U+04AB -> U+015F) follow the official ISO 9:1995 repertoire but cannot be
   cell-verified against this print. UNCERTAIN - flagged for the maps-fix pipeline.
10. Table 3 #61 (barred-o + diaeresis): the printed Latin mark reads as diaeresis or
    double-acute at available magnification; the map encodes double-acute (U+0150) per
    the official repertoire. Row excluded; UNCERTAIN - flagged.
Bookkeeping: 132 rows generated (all pass end-to-end through the ts runtime); the five
map hand tests are retained; Table 1 #17/#21/#24 Latin marks (j-caron, l-circumflex,
n-circumflex) were re-verified at 900 dpi against the print before generation; the
excluded rows above are the complete set of printed rows not generated. Table 3's
basic-letter rows duplicate Table 1's readings (the table repeats them); both are kept
as printed because Table 3's rows stand on their own. Regenerating via
scripts/gen-row-tests.mjs from this artifact reproduces the embedded block
byte-for-byte.
